fields.title: What goes with higher falls rates? Ward-months (example)

sample.caseTitle: Quality, workforce and finance in the medicine division
sample.look: Training compliance, sickness and agency use each have a clear link with falls once the others are taken into account, and training makes the biggest difference. Division adds nothing on top: Medicine’s higher falls are explained by its workforce measures, not by being Medicine.
